exposure: Alveolar capillary dysplasia with misalignment of pulmonary veins (ACD/MPV)
cohort: A premature newborn male born at 29 weeks gestational age with a birth weight of 850g and intrauterine growth restriction, presenting with severe respiratory distress minutes after birth.
finding: Lung ultrasound (LU) can provide essential information for earlier and more effective diagnosis and follow-up of persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn, and is suitable for routine monitoring of lung disease in the NICU.
